system.summary: Consonant signs carrying a superscript odd digit for the vowel (1=a 3=e 5=i 7=o 9=u), bare letter-like signs for single letters (two or more for a, e, l, r, t, u), number groups for doubled consonants (11 rr, 12 ss, 13 tt ...) and as codes for persons and powers (23 His Majesty, 22 France ...), and nulls (some number groups and marks).
system.notes: distinct_symbols = distinct labels in blind/BLIND.tsv with '?' stripped (both letters), not key rows. Key: 34 bare signs, 18 consonant bases x 5 vowel digits, 33 number or mark entries (key_corsi_w17_frozen.json); 13 of them code values in brackets, several with '?' in the key. key_order: the vowel digits run 1-3-5-7-9 for a-e-i-o-u; the consonant bases are not in order (our reading of the key, not checked against a key sheet).

prior_solution.where: Doc. 627 of the same filza carries a contemporary decipherment of its cipher block at the foot of c. 635r (the key source). For docs 620 and 623 no earlier reading was found: Desjardins, Negociations II pp. 591-595 prints clear extracts of Corsi only; this repository (upstream ca48c89, catalogue 2391 bare, no folder, no lead, no open PR); web searches. Not checked: MAP printed inventory vol. 4, Spanish-side editions, Google Books / HathiTrust phrases, DECODE (PRIOR_ART.md). Prior art not complete.

conditions.human_role: Malcolm McBratney directed the work and set the rules (prior art first, key and transcription frozen before one decode, a blind reader, a separate strict judge, first pass as the figure of record, shuffled-key controls). solution.what: Prior art for catalogue 2391/2392: this repository (clone c59841ba), Desjardins Negociations II (Corsi clear extracts pp. 591-595 only; Pucci doc. 644 printed p. 665), two web searches; the documents themselves: doc. 627 c. 635r has a contemporary decipherment at the foot; doc. 622 is a copy of 623.

Key built from the contemporary decipherment at the foot of doc. 627 c. 635r, extended by the syllabary rule (consonant base + odd superscript 1=a 3=e 5=i 7=o 9=u) and by context in 620 (key_corsi_10nov_frozen.json). Wave 17 added five bare signs (P, Ko, sg, bt, Ri) and two number-table entries (#1 = x, '.' = null) from context and copy 621; no existing value changed (key_corsi_w17_frozen.json).
Non-blind first-reader shares (firm tokens / all tokens): 633 95.7%, 620 93.8%, 623 90.3%, 627 89.9%. Made before any freeze, by readers who knew the key; not the figure of record.

Collision check on upstream/main ca48c89: no target folder on MAP CXXXVII 620-633 or Corsi; catalogue 2391 bare; no lead; no open PR. Nearest key pandolfini1514 is of the same family but a different table.

ASF iipsrv requests 00:39-00:48Z failed (connection reset). Keys frozen 00:49:07Z (FREEZE.txt). Images A0001329, A0001330, A0001341, A0001342 fetched 01:18Z at 1272 px (md5 in documents[].transcription.source).

Blind transcription of the cipher runs of 620 and 623 from the four images and the name-only label sheet blind/SHEET.md (sign names from the key, no values); 36 rows, 1,044 tokens; frozen 01:34:02Z with the key hash (blind/FREEZE_blind.txt).
One decode with key_corsi_w17_frozen.json by blind/decode_once.py, no edits (blind/decode_once.txt): 938 tokens with a letter value, 58 number entries, 29 holes, 19 nulls.

Separate strict judge, one pass, from decode_once.txt only (blind/JUDGE_BRIEF.txt): each letter unit S (sense), E (one slip) or N. Doc. 620: 633/847 = 74.7% S, S+E 91.3%. Doc. 623: 370/668 = 55.4% S, S+E 75.7%.

Dictionary-cover control (blind/shuffle.py): share of the decode covered by words of 3+ letters from an Ariosto/Dante list, codes left out; 5,000 shuffled keys per seed. Doc. 620: real 0.6902; seed 20261112 0/5,000 as good (max 0.6021); seed 7 0/5,000 (max 0.5838).
The same control on doc. 623: real 0.573; seed 20261112 2/5,000 as good (max 0.6); seed 7 3/5,000 (max 0.581).

texts.label: Corsi to Lorenzo de' Medici, 27 Oct 1513, doc. 620
texts.summary: Corsi reports that the king's side did not call the Florentine ambassador to a communication, which he thinks was handled with the nuncio; Almazán told him in a first meeting that it is written from there that the Florentine state is not well purged nor strengthened. Corsi calls this a falsehood, says the citizens and nobles share the Medici's fortune, and hopes the Italian states confederate with the king will hold firm.
texts.note: read_share is the strict judge's S share of letter units (633/847), first pass; S+E 0.913. Holes and slips left as decoded; no emendation.

texts.label: Corsi to Lorenzo de' Medici, 16 Nov 1513, doc. 623
texts.summary: Holes in most sentences. Recognisable: news from Rome that the state is not firm; His Majesty says he does not want to prolong the truce with France; the death of code 27 (King of Scots?) and code 24 (England?); the danger to the affairs of Italy.
texts.note: read_share is the strict judge's S share (370/668), first pass; S+E 0.757. The identification of 27 and 24 is doubtful in the key itself.

outcome.notes: Both documents are decoded, not read: docs/_check_reading.py finds 3 of 16 sentences clean in reading_620.md (0.188) and 0 of 16 in reading_623.md. The strict judge's letter-unit figures (620: 633/847 = 74.7%; 623: 370/668 = 55.4%; first pass, no emendation) are evidence only. The repository's docs/_validate.py was not run; the controls are the dictionary-cover shuffles in blind/shuffle_out.txt. The 10 Nov working files are dated on Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24267269 (stated by the contributor; not checked here).
